name: Saint Cecilia
history: A Roman virgin and martyr whose name is said in the Roman Canon. The story of her martyrdom says she sang to God in her heart, and so she became the patron of music and musicians. Her body was found incorrupt in 1599.
meditation: Sing, or listen to, one piece of sacred music today with full attention.
prayer: O God, Who gladden us by the annual feast of blessed Cecilia, Your Virgin and Martyr, grant, we beseech You, that we may by virtuous conduct follow her whom we venerate in this sacred rite. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
